about: The Champions' Challenge in the Champions' Guild's basement (post-quest step 9, ChampionsChallenge.kt): Larxus by the Champion Statue, at the tile of his OSRS Wiki map (read 2026-11-19). The champions come in for each duel and aren't spawned here. Left out: the six Champions of Champions seated as Mystery figures, whose seats no source gives.

spawns.source: Larxus, in the basement's gallery. OSRS Wiki, Larxus (3187,9758); the wander range guessed
